name: Resources Demo (art, help, prefs, translation)
author: neostryder
description: A framework proof, not a mod anyone plays: it keeps the resource seam (MOD_REACH gap 7) exercised. Four of the six categories a mod can supply without being compiled into the app - the title screen's art, a help page, a pref file and a TRANSLATION - each in its own file, declared in `resources`, and each read by the part of the game that owns it. The translation is a pseudo-locale (`en-XA`): readable English with every letter accented and every string bracketed, which is how a localization is checked for strings the code forgot to route through the translator - anything still in plain ASCII was missed. The other two categories need bytes too big to keep in the tree for a dev-only demo: a complete font is tens of kilobytes and a sound pack is audio. Both are proven from real files on disk by mod-resources.node.test.ts instead. Dev builds only.
